answer: Locks are recorded in summit, expire in forge, and reef lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 154 aliases therefore needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3921 identities would post 2154 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
